  const body={version:2,request_id:id(seq++),date:today,work_id:id(100),external_id:null,provider_id:id(300),name:'Externo leitores sintético',role:'servente',expected_revision:0};const pre=await call(a,10,'fn_folha_operar_v2',['external_team_add',body,false,null]);const created=await call(a,10,'fn_folha_operar_v2',['external_team_add',body,true,pre.versao]);readerExternalId=created.changed_keys[0].person_id;
  const record={version:2,request_id:id(seq++),date:today,work_id:id(100),key:{kind:'external',person_id:readerExternalId,date:today,work_id:id(100)},expected_revision:0,intervals:[{start:'08:00',end:'12:00'},{start:'13:00',end:'17:00'}]};const preview=await call(a,10,'fn_folha_operar_v2',['save',record,false,null]);const saved=await call(a,10,'fn_folha_operar_v2',['save',record,true,preview.versao]);assert.equal(saved.committed,true);assert.deepEqual(await call(a,10,'fn_folha_operar_v2',['save',record,true,preview.versao]),saved);

 });

 const hreport=(actor,kind=null,work=100,provider=null)=>as(a,actor,'SELECT fn_folha_relatorio_horas_v3($1::uuid,$2::date,$3::date,$4::text,$5::uuid) v',[id(work),today,today,kind,provider]);
 await t.test('HOURS factual read: 9h stays 9h, scope totals exact, no HE/cost exposure',async()=>{
  const before=await snapJ();const r=await hreport(13);assert.equal(r.version,3);assert.equal(r.classification_included,false);assert.equal(r.financial_effect,false);
  assert.equal(r.records.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.minutes,0),r.daily.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.minutes,0));assert.equal(r.records.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.minutes,0),r.weekly.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.minutes,0));assert.equal(r.records.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.minutes,0),r.monthly.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.minutes,0));
  assert.ok(r.records.length);for(const x of r.records){assert.equal(x.he_estado,undefined);assert.equal(x.overtime,undefined);assert.equal(x.expected_minutes,undefined);assert.equal(x.valor_hora,undefined);}
  assert.deepEqual(await snapJ(),before);
 });

 });
